What's new in 0.28.0

• Faster browsing: Home, Discover, Movies, Series and Anime open from what was loaded last time and refresh in the background. Other sections load while you're on Home.
• Settings > Playback: Maximum file size (2 to 40 GB) and Sort sources (best match, highest quality, largest or smallest).
• Watch Challenges: posters light up as you watch them, a Seen stamp lands on each new one, and finishing a challenge gets its own moment.
• Zylo Wrapped: numbers count up over your year's own artwork.
• This or That: the one you pass on fades to grey and falls away.
• Up and Down between rows go to the title directly below, not the one at the same number.
